texts.content:
Small intelligent creatures (whether diminutive humans, gray-type alien variants,
or corporeal demonic entities) are often transformed into Imps within the
Crimson Plague swarm.

These hearts are far more than trophies. Imps convert them into living capsules,
packing them with larvae they appear to produce autonomously.
The result is a biological bomb, deployed to spread the plague in densely
populated or fortified zones. Their behavior is ritualistic, almost theatrical,
and their presence often heralds large-scale outbreaks.
Though small in stature, their tactical intelligence and rapid
replication make them critical
assets in the swarm’s expansion strategy.

Despite their low metabolic demand, these infected are remarkably
agile and lethally efficient. Their appetite is modest compared to
other forms, yet their sadism is markedly higher: they specialize in
extracting still-beating hearts from victims, using their speed to
strike vital points with surgical precision.
